node.title: Re^2: -E behavior with stdin script (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
AFAIK, there is no way to pick the features enabled by -E automatically other than by using it.

Well, -E is [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/blob/756f0910f/toke.c#L8796|equivalent] to a use feature ':5.XX';, so one slightly hackish way to get the same effect is use feature ":5.".(0+substr($],2,3));.

Update: Crossposting the following better solution from [id://11136456|my other node] for completeness:

use Config; use feature ":$Config{PERL_REVISION}.$Config{PERL_VERSION}";
